snippet.title: Trailer | Mecharashi is Available Worldwide! Download It Now!
snippet.description:
As the war rages on, the future remains unknown...
Hero, your journey's not done yet. Keep moving.
March on... until a true dawn finally breaks.
Mecharashi Officially Launches Today!
Download it now from the official website, App Store, or Google Play.

Mecharashi is now live worldwide! Download now to get in on the launch event and grab yourself some epic rewards!
